concept_decisions: Retain concept coarse open fold, thick contrasting mineral bands, chunky broken faces. Simplify photoreal microtexture into integrated angular coarse mineral facets. Use one closed surface mesh with folded full-depth foliation coordinates, physical differential erosion ribs; no colored shells or coplanar tiles. Eight coarse uneven bands, not dozens of BIF laminae. Avoid treating the crosscutting pale veins in supplemental USGS DeathValley photo as foliation.
repair_design: Actual BVH found14 intersections, principally near lower cap from fold amplification and upper boundary. Actual top pixels show undesirable radial triangle striping/starburst. Replace cap with shared-boundary Cartesian triangulated coarse broken top; use monotonic bounded fold deformation and low-frequency grain relief. Preserve coarse8-band folded scope, not camera/material bias concealment. Retain all failed r002 outputs.
